column1: # Numerals, one line per word and reading: word, reading (hiragana), senses
# separated by " | ". These replace Wiktionary's numerals, nouns and kanji
# entries for each word (apps/importer/src/numerals.ts): it gives 九 eight
# entries that all say "nine", with mahjong readings, and 五 only nouns.
# The common reading comes first; the native one says where it is read.
